body:
这次拉潘摩擦的调查报告太搞笑了，拉潘闹麻真是f1届难忘今宵，，，感觉就像拉潘两公婆吵架说现在说的是你的态度问题！！！赛会调查：如果态度有用的话要警察干嘛
During the hearing, the drivers also discussed the 【informal gentlemen's agreements】concerning the preparation for a flying lap and the conduct expected between drivers in such situations. The Stewards noted these explanations but considered that such informal understandings were 【of limited relevance】to the assessment of the incident.
